content: Though Bengali is the seventh most spoken language in terms of number of native speakers BIBREF23, there is no standard corpus of questions available BIBREF0. We have collected total 3500 questions from the Internet and other sources such as books of general knowledge questions, history etc. The corpus contains the questions and the classes each question belongs to.
